hero.title: Trade smarter. <grow>Grow</grow> your portfolio with confidence.
hero.subtitle: TradeLinked gives you real-time market access, transparent ledgers, and a dedicated support team — everything you need to invest with clarity.

fastProgress.title: Fast progress
fastProgress.body: See deposits, profits and withdrawals reflected in your ledger in real time. Every movement is recorded, so you always know where your balance stands.

modernPlatform.title: A modern platform
modernPlatform.body: One place for live market data, your portfolio and support. Built mobile-first, so it works as smoothly on your phone as on your desktop — and installs like an app.

about.heading: About <brand>TradeLinked</brand>
about.lead: A trading and investment portal built around transparency, speed and direct support.
about.body: TradeLinked gives clients real-time access to global markets, a full audit trail for every balance change, and a support team that is a message away. We keep the experience simple: fund your account, activate a plan, and watch your portfolio in one clear dashboard.
about.disclaimer: Trading involves risk. Figures shown on this page are illustrative and are not a guarantee of future results.
about.chartCaption: Portfolio performance · sample data for illustration
about.anywhereHeading: Access and manage all your investments from anywhere
about.anywhereBody: Your dashboard follows you across devices. Install TradeLinked to your home screen for one-tap access to live markets, your balance and your ledger.

howItWorks.heading: How TradeLinked works
howItWorks.subtitle: A straightforward process in four steps — from creating your account to withdrawing funds.

create.title: Create your account
create.body: Register with your email in under a minute. Your dashboard, ledger and support access are ready as soon as you sign in.

fund.title: Fund your balance
fund.body: Open Quick Deposit in your dashboard and send funds using the payment details shown. Our team credits your balance once the transfer is confirmed.

activate.title: Activate a plan and track it
activate.body: Contact support to activate the plan that suits you, then follow every credit and debit in your live ledger as it happens.

withdraw.title: Withdraw when you're ready
withdraw.body: Submit a withdrawal request from your dashboard. It is reviewed by our team and you are emailed the moment it is approved or declined.

plans.heading: Investment Plans
plans.subtitle: Choose a plan that fits your investment goals.
plans.drawerBody: To get started with the <plan>{name}</plan> plan, reach out to our support team. They will guide you through funding your account and activating the plan.

payments.heading: Accepted payment methods
payments.subtitle: Fund your account with widely used, convenient payment options. The exact deposit details are shown securely inside your dashboard.

security.heading: Built on Security
security.subtitle: Your capital and data are protected at every layer.

encryption.title: Bank-grade encryption
encryption.description: All data in transit and at rest is encrypted with industry-standard AES-256.

custody.title: Segregated custody
custody.description: Client funds are held separately from operating capital at all times.

auth.title: Secure authentication
auth.description: Session-based auth with row-level security on every database query.

audit.title: Full audit trail
audit.description: Every balance change is logged and traceable in your ledger history.

partners.heading: Our strategic partners
partners.subtitle: TradeLinked has partnered with multiple projects, enhancing our global market presence.

cta.heading: Ready to start?
cta.body: Create your free account today and explore the platform at your own pace.

chat.title: Customer Support
chat.greeting: Hello! How can I help you today?
chat.replyWhatsApp: Thanks for your message! Our support team can pick this up with you directly on WhatsApp.
chat.replyLogin: Thanks for your message! Please log in or register and our support team will assist you from there.

deposit.label: How do I deposit?
deposit.answer: Create an account, open your dashboard and tap Quick Deposit. Send funds using the details shown there, and our team credits your balance once the transfer is confirmed.

withdraw.label: How do withdrawals work?
withdraw.answer: Submit a withdrawal request from your dashboard. Our team reviews it and you'll get an email as soon as it is approved or declined.

plans.label: Which plans are available?
plans.answer: We offer Starter, Growth and Elite plans. See the Investment Plans section on this page for deposit ranges and features, then contact support to activate one.

person.label: Talk to a person
person.answer: Happy to connect you with our support team.
person.handoff: Hello, I'd like to speak to support.

acceptance.heading: 1. Acceptance
acceptance.body: By creating an account you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the platform.

account.heading: 2. Your account
account.body: You must provide accurate information and keep your login credentials confidential. You are responsible for all activity on your account.

transactions.heading: 3. Deposits and withdrawals
transactions.body: Deposits are credited after our team confirms receipt. Withdrawal requests are reviewed before approval and may be rejected or delayed for verification, security or compliance reasons.

restrictions.heading: 4. Account restrictions
restrictions.body: We may freeze or close accounts that breach these Terms or that we reasonably suspect of misuse.

changes.heading: 5. Changes
changes.body: We may update these Terms. Continued use of the platform means you accept the updated version.

collect.heading: Information we collect
collect.body: We collect the details you give us when registering (name, email) and records of your account activity such as deposits, withdrawals and ledger entries.

use.heading: How we use it
use.body: To operate your account, process transactions, send service emails (such as withdrawal updates), secure the platform and meet legal obligations.

sharing.heading: Sharing
sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with service providers that help us run the platform (for example hosting and email delivery) or where the law requires.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: You can contact support to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data.

highRisk.heading: Trading carries a high level of risk
highRisk.body: Trading foreign exchange, stocks, crypto-assets and other leveraged products involves substantial risk and is not suitable for everyone. You may lose some or all of your invested capital.

noGuarantee.heading: No guarantee of returns
noGuarantee.body: Past performance is not a reliable indicator of future results. Any figures shown on this site are illustrative and are not a promise or guarantee of profit.

affordToLose.heading: Only invest what you can afford to lose
affordToLose.body: Before investing, consider your objectives, experience and financial situation, and seek independent financial advice if you are unsure.

marketRisk.heading: Market and liquidity risk
marketRisk.body: Prices can move quickly and unpredictably. Market conditions may delay or prevent the execution of transactions.
